name: Cyber-AI @ USD
org: University of San Diego, Center for Cyber Security Engineering and Technology
what_you_do: Spend five days at USD learning how to keep computers safe and how AI helps. Teachers and tech workers lead it. You try real tools in labs and games.
pay_detail: The page does not list a cost. Daily lunch is included.
how_to_apply: The page has no application link. Email cybercenter@sandiego.edu or call (619) 260-4564 to ask about the next session.
notes: Confirm first: the page lists no dates, cost or application. Its wording speaks to parents about investing in the program, so ask whether there is a fee and whether aid is offered.
